arabic.name: Five Minutes Together – Omani teacher (Arabic)
arabic.category: generated (Voice Design on the ElevenLabs website)
arabic.how: The Voice Design API was refused on the free plan (HTTP 403 feature_not_available: "Creating a voice through the API is only available on a paid plan."), so the voice is designed on the website with the same description and preview text (brief §5), and its voice ID is pasted into the studio page.
arabic.description: A warm, kind Omani woman in her early thirties, an experienced Grade 1 teacher in Oman, speaking gently to parents at home. Native Omani Gulf Arabic accent while reading clear, simple Modern Standard Arabic. Calm, reassuring and encouraging; moderate, slightly slow pace; very clear consonants; clean studio recording with no background noise or music.
arabic.preview_text: مرحبًا بكم. في خمس دقائق كل يوم، يتعلّم طفلك أصوات الحروف الإنجليزية معك في البيت. اسأل طفلك: ما أول صوت في الكلمة؟ ضع يدك أمام فمك لتشعر بالهواء، وشجّعه بعد كل محاولة.
